svg.text: The users changed shape: assistants became agents
Top 50 OpenRouter apps, monthly. Tokens per request rose from 16.9k in Jan 2025 to 75.5k in Sep 2026 (4.5×).
The bottom panel is the composition of those top-50 tokens at every month; a falling share is not a falling app. The market grew in requests and in length.
Cline and Roo Code were 75.2% of the top-50 app tokens in January 2025.
OpenClaw peaked at 53.3% in March 2026; by September 2026 Hermes Agent was 27.8%, Claude Code 13.7% and Kilo Code 9.5%.
Tokens per request rose 4.5× over the record. The app mix turned over at least as fast: four different leaders in twenty-one months. Both archives are read directly, never captured.
Source: OpenRouter app-rankings, 21 monthly windows, top 50 apps; as of 2026-10-26T10:14:40.162Z.
